questions: Should the series length be exactly the number of days in the range (i.e., (end_date - start_date).days + 1) or the number of days difference (i.e., (end_date - start_date).days)?
If start_date equals end_date, should the series contain exactly one copy of that date (as per the clarification) or zero dates?
Should the random selection be with replacement (dates can repeat) or without replacement (each date appears at most once)?
Should the series be sorted in chronological order or remain in the random order of generation?
Should the series index be a default RangeIndex or should it be dates or something else?
Should the random integer selection for days use a uniform distribution over all possible days (including start and end), or some other distribution?
If seed is None, should the random number generator be unseeded (using system randomness) or should it default to 42?
Should the output series contain datetime.datetime objects with time components set to 00:00:00, or preserve any time component from start_date/end_date?
